1. docs/DXIL.rst:1876-1887 -- AtomicBinOp 'Valid resource type' table.
   CLAIM: Texture2DMS / Texture2DMSArray are NOT listed.
==============================================================================
 1870:       i32,                  ; coordinate c1
 1871:       i32,                  ; coordinate c2
 1872:       i32)                  ; new value
 1873: 
 1874: The call respects SM5.1 OOB and alignment rules.
 1875: 
 1876: =================== =====================================================
 1877: Valid resource type # of active coordinates
 1878: =================== =====================================================
 1879: RWTexture1D         1 (c0)
 1880: RWTexture1DArray    2 (c0, c1 = array slice)
 1881: RWTexture2D         2 (c0, c1)
 1882: RWTexture2DArray    3 (c0, c1, c2 = array slice)
 1883: RWTexture3D         3 (c0, c1, c2)
 1884: RWTypedBuffer       1 (c0 in elements)
 1885: RWRawBuffer         1 (c0 in bytes)
 1886: RWStructuredBuffer  2 (c0 in elements, c1 - byte offset into the element)
 1887: =================== =====================================================
 1888: 
 1889: AtomicBinOp subsumes corresponding DXBC atomic operations that do not return the old value in memory. The driver compiler is free to specialize the corresponding GPU instruction if the return value is unused.
 1890: 
 1891: AtomicCompareExchange
 1892: ~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~

2. lib/HLSL/HLOperationLower.cpp:4906-4949 -- TranslateAtomicBinaryOperation.
   CLAIM: all 3 coords init to undefI, filled only as far as the address vector
          reaches; no multisample branch, so no path can supply a sample index.
==============================================================================
 4906: void TranslateAtomicBinaryOperation(AtomicHelper &helper,
 4907:                                     DXIL::AtomicBinOpCode atomicOp,
 4908:                                     IRBuilder<> &Builder, hlsl::OP *hlslOP) {
 4909:   Value *handle = helper.handle;
 4910:   Value *addr = helper.addr;
 4911:   Value *val = helper.value;
 4912:   Type *Ty = helper.operationType;
 4913:   Type *valTy = val->getType();
 4914: 
 4915:   Value *undefI = UndefValue::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Ty->getContext()));
 4916: 
 4917:   Function *dxilAtomic = hlslOP->GetOpFunc(helper.opcode, Ty->getScalarType());
 4918:   Value *opArg = hlslOP->GetU32Const(static_cast<unsigned>(helper.opcode));
 4919:   Value *atomicOpArg = hlslOP->GetU32Const(static_cast<unsigned>(atomicOp));
 4920: 
 4921:   if (Ty != valTy)
 4922:     val = Builder.CreateBitCast(val, Ty);
 4923: 
 4924:   Value *args[] = {opArg,  handle, atomicOpArg,
 4925:                    undefI, undefI, undefI, // coordinates
 4926:                    val};
 4927: 
 4928:   // Setup coordinates.
 4929:   if (addr->getType()->isVectorTy()) {
 4930:     unsigned vectorNumElements = addr->getType()->getVectorNumElements();
 4931:     DXASSERT(vectorNumElements <= 3, "up to 3 elements for atomic binary op");
 4932:     assert(vectorNumElements <= 3);
 4933:     for (unsigned i = 0; i < vectorNumElements; i++) {
 4934:       Value *Elt = Builder.CreateExtractElement(addr, i);
 4935:       args[DXIL::OperandIndex::kAtomicBinOpCoord0OpIdx + i] = Elt;
 4936:     }
 4937:   } else
 4938:     args[DXIL::OperandIndex::kAtomicBinOpCoord0OpIdx] = addr;
 4939: 
 4940:   // Set offset for structured buffer.
 4941:   if (helper.offset)
 4942:     args[DXIL::OperandIndex::kAtomicBinOpCoord1OpIdx] = helper.offset;
 4943: 
 4944:   Value *origVal =
 4945:       Builder.CreateCall(dxilAtomic, args, hlslOP->GetAtomicOpName(atomicOp));
 4946:   if (helper.originalValue) {
 4947:     if (Ty != valTy)
 4948:       origVal = Builder.CreateBitCast(origVal, valTy);
 4949:     Builder.CreateStore(origVal, helper.originalValue);
 4950:   }

 2429:     }
 2430:     // CreateHandle should not be used in SM 6.6 and above:
 2431:     if (DXIL::CompareVersions(ValCtx.m_DxilMajor, ValCtx.m_DxilMinor, 1, 5) >

4. lib/Support/ErrorHandling.cpp:143 -- llvm_cast_assert_internal.
   CLAIM: a failed llvm::cast<> THROWS hlsl::Exception rather than asserting, so the
          ICE exits E_FAIL identically in Debug and Release.
==============================================================================
  130:     OS << msg << "\n";
  131:   OS << "UNREACHABLE executed";
  132:   if (file)
  133:     OS << " at " << file << ":" << line;
  134:   OS << "!\n";
  135: #ifndef LLVM_ON_WIN32 // HLSL Change - unwind if necessary, but don't terminate the process
  136:   dbgs() << OS.str();
  137:   abort();
  138: #else
  139:   throw hlsl::Exception(DXC_E_LLVM_UNREACHABLE, OS.str());
  140: #endif
  141: }
  142: 
  143: void llvm::llvm_cast_assert_internal(const char *func) {
  144:   throw hlsl::Exception(DXC_E_LLVM_CAST_ERROR, std::string(func) + "<X>() argument of incompatible type!\n");
